model: facebook/jepa-wms EncPredWM (DINOv3 ViT-L/16 encoder 303M frozen + 12-layer AdaLN predictor 229M, jepa_wm_droid.pth.tar epoch 315)
policy_server: sim/scripts/serve_jepawms.py @ http://127.0.0.1:8773 (conda surgi_track; repo-faithful CEMPlanner + ReprTargetDistMPCObjective L2-on-final-latent, horizon=3, var_scale=0.1, max_norms=[0.1,0.75], elites=10, iters=15, samples=300)

adapter.policy_output: 7-d DROID actions [dxyz3, dEuler_xyz3 world-frame left-mult, dclosedness1], integrated via repo compute_new_pose onto measured left pose -> absolute 20-d rows; R_* echoes
adapter.obs: current cam_high encoded per query (task_specification.num_frames=1); goal = frame 330 of episode_002_seed7.mp4 (post-grasp lift) encoded once
adapter.deviation_from_repo_eval: none in the deployed run: server launched --iters 15 --samples 300 (repo-faithful droid_L2_cem eval config), measured 99.8 s/query on GB10; the script docstring's cheaper --iters 8 --samples 128 default was NOT what ran

notes: Sharper landscape than V-JEPA2-AC (5.5% mean vs ~1.5-2.7%) but same failure signature: coherent motion drifting away from block (min EE->block 791 mm), grip channel partially tracking the goal frame's closed gripper (mean 0.55). Rollout launched manually by parent after agent's blind retry loop exhausted on the libgomp banner; LD_PRELOAD=libgomp.so.1 + OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA=YES required.
